title: Website Policies
section: UIDAI is a statutory authority established and governed under the provisions of the Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits, and Services) Act, 2016 (as amended), along with the regulations framed thereunder.  I. Certain features and services on the Platforms (including myAadhaar portal) may require you to provide personal information, including 'Personally Identifiable Information'. II. If you do not wish to use these specific features or services, UIDAI will only collect non-personal information such as usage logs and technical data. III. You are responsible for ensuring the correctness and accuracy of the Personally Identifiable Information you submit on any of our Platforms. Providing inaccurate information may affect your ability to access or use the Platform(s). C. INFORMATION COLLECTION **I. COLLECTION OF PERSONAL INFORMATION**      The UIDAI website primarily provides information, while associated portals (such as myAadhaar) enable residents to access Aadhaar-related services online. The UIDAI website primarily does not automatically capture personal information (such as name, Aadhaar number, phone number, or email address). However, for accessing services on associated portals (such as myAadhaar), users may be required to provide limited personal information such as mobile number, Aadhaar number/VID, and OTP for authentication and service delivery purposes. Such information is collected only for lawful purposes, including authentication, service delivery, and security. Where applicable, demographic information may be retrieved securely from UIDAI systems for providing requested services, in accordance with applicable laws and user consent. D. USE OF INFORMATION UIDAI records usage logs, authentication events, and service interactions for statistical, security, and audit purposes. UIDAI makes no attempt to identify individuals beyond what is required for service delivery and security monitoring. UIDAI shall not disclose and/or share demographic details and/or authentication logs, to any third party(public/private) except in accordance with the provisions of applicable laws, including the Aadhaar Act and regulations framed there under.     Information collected may be used for:   • Providing Aadhaar-related services   • Authentication and verification   • Security monitoring and fraud prevention   • System performance and analytics      System logs, session data, and interaction history may be temporarily stored for audit, troubleshooting, and security purposes. E. COOKIES & SESSION MANAGEMENT UIDAI website and associated portals may use session-based cookies or similar technologies to manage user sessions and improve service delivery. These do not store personally identifiable information. F. E-MAIL MANAGEMENT Your e-mail address will only be recorded if you choose to send a message.
